sections.title: Sociology and Environmental Studies Combined Major Credit Requirement
heading_path: Sociology and Environmental Studies Combined Major Credit Requirement

entries.text: Complete 79 semester hours in the major.

college: College of Social Sciences and Humanities
overview_text: This combined major provides broad awareness of the sociological and scientific foundations of environmental problem solving. Students have the opportunity to develop concrete skills in GIS and scientific communication that will facilitate their success. Due to overlap in course content, students majoring in environmental studies or any environmental studies combined major may not complete a minor in environmental and sustainability sciences.
